description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline component, specifically testing the data handling aspects such as need data notifications, adding segments, and state transitions within the media pipeline. It uses mocks and fixtures to simulate media pipeline behavior and verifies correct interactions and state management.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineDataTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for media pipeline data handling tests, setting up mocks, media pipeline, and test scenarios.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates media pipeline, sets default state, and prepares shared memory info.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up resources, deletes frames, and destroys media pipeline after each test.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source with a specified source ID to the media pipeline.

methods.name: needDataGeneric
methods.description: Triggers a generic need data notification with current source ID, frame count, request ID, and shared memory info.

methods.name: addFrames
methods.description: Adds a specified number of frames of a given media source type with provided data to the media pipeline.

methods.name: deleteFrames
methods.description: Deletes all stored frames from the internal vector.

methods.name: haveDataSuccess
methods.description: Simulates a successful haveData call, indicating data is available.

methods.name: createFrame
methods.description: Creates a media segment frame of specified type, size, and data, with optional timestamp.

methods.name: startAddSegmentThread
methods.description: Starts a thread that adds a media segment to the pipeline, simulating asynchronous frame addition.
